Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and applicable prebuild gate.

## Validation

- Commands actually run, environment, and results:
- Checks not run and why:
- New or changed regression coverage:

## Review

- [ ] Implementation and documentation agree about completed versus planned work.
- [ ] Fixtures and evidence contain synthetic data only; no tokens or personal data.
- [ ] Changed dependencies, licenses, schema compatibility, and migrations are explained.
- [ ] Historical results have not been relabeled as a new passing run.

For security vulnerabilities, use the process in SECURITY.md before opening a public PR.
